signals.summary: The seasonal pivot indoors — 'fall vibes' kitchens, covered porches, conversation pits and candle-lit rooms — arriving early while it is still summer outside.
signals.why_now: Seven fresh r/CozyPlaces / r/selfcare posts within ~34h: 'What do you advise for a cosy night in? 🍵' (0.2h), 'Fall vibes in my kitchen 🍂' (0.3h), 'Our covered porch' (3.5h), 'Summer night in northern Norway' (7.7h), 'Our cozy living room 🛋️' (11.3h), 'Cozy days in the conversation pit' (20.6h) and 'August outside, October inside my apartment 🍂🎃' (33.8h).

signals.summary: Pen-and-paper journaling as a daily ritual — reading journals, custom spreads, fountain pens and sticky-note flatlays — shot as tidy desk-and-notebook scenes.
signals.why_now: A dominant, near-continuous r/Journaling stream — 10-plus posts within ~26h including 'started a reading journal' (10.1h), 'Daily journal with Midori + Zebra' (22h), 'Woodsy sticky notes' (15.4h), 'I was afraid of ruining it, but now I'm enjoying it' (15.3h) and 'fastest i've ever filled a journal' (21.7h).

signals.summary: A softer minimalism — natural materials and warmth over cold white space — paired with a steady decluttering-as-relief thread.
signals.why_now: Trade and community items within ~50h: 'Try the new warm minimalism trend... natural materials' (49.8h), 'It's freeing to have less clutter' (36.1h), 'Weekend declutter' (33.2h) and 'I bought some stuff today' regret (30.2h).
